record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, weight each valid position's existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise loss by 1+exp2(-d/4), where d is its distance from the final valid target position. Normalize by the sum of valid weights. Emphasizing recent next-item predictions may better match final-history HR@10 while retaining prefix supervision. Preserve sampling, embeddings, GRU topology, causal readout, optimizer and training settings; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Weight valid targets by 1+exp2(-d/4), where d is the distance from each sequence's final valid target. This emphasizes recent predictions while retaining prefix supervision across all four datasets.
